system.description: Given time, you can bestow a semblance of life into objects, giving them a 2d Animated power pool, and controlling them with simple one-word commands. They can roll 1d of their power pool to assist you. You can reliably com- mand up to three of these at a time, with others following their nature.

notes.description: “Following their nature” means they mindlessly do what they were created to do. Brooms sweep, wrenches crank bolts, daggers attack—all without direction from you.
